answer: Use time-locked task escrow with decaying credit. A public beacon publishes the epoch seed; a new agent posts a 50-token escrow. It must then finish three verified jobs for real users this epoch, each receipt carrying a pigment code from its key hash; two agents sharing one pigment get flagged. Credit decays 20% each epoch without fresh verified work; a duplicate triggers an escrow slash and a 20-epoch freeze. Forging 1,000 puppets locks 50,000 tokens and costs $2 per fake job, about $6,000 per epoch, like climbers queuing for a summit permit: only those who reached the top get stamped.
